settings_subtitle: Manage your account and app preferences.
settings_hub_hotel_profile_desc: Legal name, address and fiscal data for invoicing, Alloggiati Web credentials
settings_hub_admin_users_desc: Create, deactivate and reset passwords for staff accounts
alloggiati_auto_send_desc: Automatically submit the Alloggiati report to the Polizia di Stato portal at each check-in
email_reservation_confirmed_desc: Email the guest when a reservation is created
email_checkout_desc: Email the guest a stay summary and invoice at check-out
email_subject_placeholder: Leave blank to use the default subject
email_greeting_desc: Appended to the footer of every email sent to guests (e.g. "We look forward to welcoming you, the team at Hotel Bella Vista")
email_greeting_placeholder: E.g. We look forward to welcoming you, the team at Hotel Bella Vista
city_tax_page_subtitle: Manage the property's classification and the municipal tourist-tax rates (art. 4 D.Lgs. 23/2011)
city_tax_category_section_desc: The category (e.g. stars) determines which rate applies. Recording a new category automatically closes the current one.
city_tax_rates_section_desc: One rate per category and comune. Recording a new rate for the same category automatically closes the current one.
settings_hub_privacy_desc: Guest data export (GDPR) and retention settings
privacy_page_subtitle: Manage guest data export and the data retention period (GDPR)
privacy_retention_section_desc: Minimum retention period for guest data from their last stay, before it becomes eligible for deletion.
privacy_err_min_years: Must be at least {{count}} years (TULPS requirement)
